caption: From the Arizona Inn. A little outside of our tax bracket, but wasn't bad for some apps and drinks. Wandered around a bit and felt moderately out of place.

Inside DeGrazia's Mission in the Sun. Very neat art museum with this lil' church on the grounds. He had some paintings of lizards and horses that I really liked. And a really nice rotating artist (blanking on her name) talked to us for a while about her glass work and just Tucson in general.
Also from the Mission in the Sun. Sky's pretty blue here.
Fresh citrus is wild. I'd like an orange tree. Maybe an orchard. Amanda Little talks about orchard management to adapt to climate change in The Fate of Food. Would recommend.
Passing through Saguaro National Park on the way back from the Desert Museum. Which is a pseudo-wild zoo. No javelinas, but some pretty sick little lizards and reptiles and otters and whatnot!

The (former) Pima County Courthouse building. Which is now a southern Arizona visitor center, and had some live music in the courtyard. Fun little spot, probably nice to do work there if it isn't ten million degrees out.
A restaurant that we didn't go to but was soooo yellow!
